title: Fourier estimator query program
statement: Let $x_1,\ldots,x_m$ be points of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube and let $U$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates. The program queries the sign encodings of all $m$ points, then uses the answers $y_1,\ldots,y_m$ to return $\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^m y_i\chi_U(\chi(x_i))$, charging $m(|U|+2)+1$ local computation steps; here $\chi$ is the coordinatewise sign map and $\chi_U$ is the character indexed by $U$.
hypotheses_covered: A sample indexed by the $m$-element set, with each point in the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube.
